label: LIVE-LITE v2
ruling: identical to v1 except ONE system-prompt addition (explicit tool use), applied to both arms; pre-registered

system_prompt_addition.mcp: First call list_metrics to see available metrics. Then call query_metric with the metric name exactly as listed. Answer only from query_metric results; if no metric fits, abstain.
system_prompt_addition.raw: First call describe_tables to see the available tables and columns. Then call run_sql with a query that uses the column names exactly as listed. Answer only from run_sql results; if the data cannot answer the question, abstain.
